jo (docs): Hey all — I'm updating the rate/usage guide to add a compact migration snippet and need quick checks. PR: https://rwd/pulls/5042. Main asks: header names matrix, short Go + JS quota example, and a note about token vs request accounting.
eli (sdk): I'll review the code. Quick pointer: the hosted API exposes X-Quota-Org, private deploys expose X-Tenant-Quota. Document both and recommend feature-detecting via the /quota endpoint.
jo (docs): Good. For the Go example I want the minimal path: call /quota, print tokens_left vs requests_left, then conditionally call generation. Keep it 8-10 lines.
eli (sdk): Here's a trimmed Go example I'll push to the PR:
```go
q, _ := client.Quota.Get(ctx)
fmt.Println(q.TokensLeft, q.RequestsLeft)
if q.RequestsLeft>0 {
  r, _ := client.Generation.Create(ctx, req)
  fmt.Println(r.ID)
}
```
jo (docs): Perfect. Two tiny edits: use v2 field names (tokens_left, requests_left) and avoid ignoring errors in examples — show basic err check.
nora (product): Please add a short paragraph explaining burst credits: multi-tenant gets per-org burst, dedicated setups use a pool. Keep it non-contractual and illustrative.
sam (analytics): Also add a troubleshooting callout: "If dashboard shows tokens but zero requests, check for ingestion/embedding jobs — tokens != requests." Saves tickets.
ci-bot: link-check: https://grafana.internal/consumption returned 403. Recommend adding a screenshot artifact instead of live link.
jo (docs): I'll attach a sanitized screenshot and add a caption noting internal access. Also adding a tiny migration checklist at top: audit headers, update SDKs, verify dashboards.
eli (sdk): Pushed field-name fix and error handling. Also updated the JS snippet to show client.quota.get().then(...).
jo (docs): Thanks — please react with :white_check_mark: when you've reviewed the PR. Planning to merge after CI and the screenshot.
